title: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.31119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic. Rubrics extracted from scientific papers can supply the critic. Existing pipelines, however, draw the question and the criteria from the same content, so the reward can be earned by paraphrase. The rubric is further compressed into a single scalar per rollout. We introduce PaperGym, a unified framework that turns each research paper into a complete training environment. PaperGym exploits the structure of a paper: the question is synthesized from the research goal and background, while the criteria are derived from the method and experiments. The criteria span methodological innovation and experimental design, and criterion leakage falls to 3.7%, versus 11.90% to 34.10% in existing datasets. Training uses the rubric twice: first as privilege

translated_title: PaperGym：面向科研计划生成的以评分标准为中心的进化
translated_abstract: 科研规划是AI科学家的决定性能力。然而，科研计划没有可验证的标准答案，因此强化学习缺乏它所必需的环境：与评判者配套的任务。从科学论文中提取的评分标准可以充当这样的评判者。然而，现有流程从同一内容中同时提取问题和评判标准，导致奖励可以通过简单改写（复述）来获得；此外，评分标准还被压缩为每次 rollout 的单个标量分数。我们提出 PaperGym，一个将每篇研究论文转化为完整训练环境的统一框架。PaperGym 利用论文的内在结构：问题由研究目标和背景部分合成，而评判标准则从方法和实验部分推导得出。这些标准涵盖方法学创新与实验设计，标准泄漏率降至 3.7%，而现有数据集的泄漏率为 11.90% 至 34.10%。训练过程中评分标准被使用两次：首先作为特权……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PaperGym 提出了一个将每篇研究论文转化为完整强化学习训练环境的统一框架，通过将问题与评判标准分别从论文的不同部分合成以消除标准泄漏（降至3.7%），并将评分标准作为细粒度评判信号用于科研计划生成的进化训练。
en_tdlr: PaperGym introduces a unified framework that turns each research paper into a complete RL training environment, synthesizing questions and rubric criteria from disjoint paper sections to reduce criterion leakage to 3.7%, and leveraging rubrics as fine-grained critic signals for evolving research-plan generation.
